## Load Libraries

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lavaan)
library(sandwich)
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(stargazer)
library(clubSandwich)
library(MASS)
library(lmtest)
library(fwildclusterboot)
library(fixest)
library(gt)
library(ivreg)
```

## Load Data & Seed

```{r}

set.seed(852347)

rawData <- read_excel("2_p3_updated.xlsx")

averagedData <- read_excel("basefinal.xlsx")
```

## Preprocess

```{r}

averagedData <- averagedData %>%
  rename(
    AttractivenessStd = ZAT3,
    FightingStd = ZLU3,
    FFAStd = ZProcustes_FA,
    fWHRStd = ZFWHR,
    BMIStd = ZIMC
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    resfWHRStd = as.numeric(scale(res_FWHR)),
    AgeStd = as.numeric(scale(Edad)),
    fWHR_FFA = fWHRStd*FFAStd
  )

dataLong <- rawData %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(ATE|LUE)\\d+$"),        # pick ATE1… and LUE1… columns
    names_to = c(".value", "Rater"),       # .value => create cols from prefixes
    names_pattern = "([A-Z]+)(\\d+)"           # capture prefix and the number
  ) %>%
    rename(
    Attractiveness = ATE,
    Fighting = LUE,
    FFA = "Procustes FA"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Rater = as.integer(Rater),
    FFAStd = as.numeric(scale(FFA)),
    fWHRStd = as.numeric(scale(fWHR)),
    AgeStd = as.numeric(scale(Edad)),
    BMIStd = as.numeric(scale(IMC)),
    
    # Center on the grand mean and scale with the variance of the averaged scores to replicate results
    AttractivenessStd = (Attractiveness - mean(Attractiveness)) / sd(rawData$ATmed),
    FightingStd = (Fighting - mean(Fighting)) / sd(rawData$LUmed),
    
    resfWHRStd = as.numeric(scale(res_fWHR)),
    Attractiveness = as.factor(Attractiveness),
    Fighting = as.factor(Fighting)
    )


```

## Set Significance

```{r}

alpha <- 0.05
```

## Main Model

```{r}

# helper to align robust SEs to the model's coef vector
robust_se <- function(model, vcov_mat) {
  se <- sqrt(diag(vcov_mat))[names(coef(model))]
  unname(as.numeric(se))
}

# Simple models
modelAttrSimple <- lm(AttractivenessStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd, data = averagedData)
AttrRobustSimpleHC <- vcovHC(modelAttrSimple, type = "HC3")
AttrRobustSimpleSE <- robust_se(modelAttrSimple, AttrRobustSimpleHC)

modelFghtSimple <- lm(FightingStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd, data = averagedData)
FghtRobustSimpleHC <- vcovHC(modelFghtSimple, type = "HC3")
FghtRobustSimpleSE <- robust_se(modelFghtSimple, FghtRobustSimpleHC)

# BMI controls
modelAttrBMI <- lm(AttractivenessStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + BMIStd, data = averagedData)
AttrRobustBMIHC <- vcovHC(modelAttrBMI, type = "HC3")
AttrRobustBMISE <- robust_se(modelAttrBMI, AttrRobustBMIHC)

modelFghtBMI <- lm(FightingStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + BMIStd, data = averagedData)
FghtRobustBMIHC <- vcovHC(modelFghtBMI, type = "HC3")
FghtRobustBMISE <- robust_se(modelFghtBMI, FghtRobustBMIHC)

# Age controls
modelAttrAge <- lm(AttractivenessStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = averagedData)
AttrRobustAgeHC <- vcovHC(modelAttrAge, type = "HC3")
AttrRobustAgeSE <- robust_se(modelAttrAge, AttrRobustAgeHC)

modelFghtAge <- lm(FightingStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = averagedData)
FghtRobustAgeHC <- vcovHC(modelFghtAge, type = "HC3")
FghtRobustAgeSE <- robust_se(modelFghtAge, FghtRobustAgeHC)

# "Full" models — note the interaction only appears in modelAttr here
modelAttr <- lm(AttractivenessStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + fWHRStd*FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = averagedData)
AttrRobustHC <- vcovHC(modelAttr, type = "HC3")
AttrRobustSE <- robust_se(modelAttr, AttrRobustHC)

modelFght <- lm(FightingStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = averagedData)
FghtRobustHC <- vcovHC(modelFght, type = "HC3")
FghtRobustSE <- robust_se(modelFght, FghtRobustHC)


stargazer(modelAttrSimple, modelAttrBMI, modelAttrAge, modelAttr,
          se=list(AttrRobustSimpleSE, AttrRobustBMISE, AttrRobustAgeSE, AttrRobustSE),
          type="text")
stargazer(modelFghtSimple, modelFghtBMI, modelFghtAge, modelFght,
          se=list(FghtRobustSimpleSE, FghtRobustBMISE, FghtRobustAgeSE, FghtRobustSE),
          type="text")
```

### Compute Robust Statistics

```{r}

# SIMPLE
AttrSimpleTest <- coeftest(modelAttrSimple, vcov.=AttrRobustSimpleHC, df=modelAttrSimple$df.residual)

FghtSimpleTest <- coeftest(modelFghtSimple, vcov.=FghtRobustSimpleHC, df=modelFghtSimple$df.residual)

# BMI

AttrBMITest <- coeftest(modelAttrBMI, vcov.=AttrRobustBMIHC, df=modelAttrBMI$df.residual)

FghtBMITest <- coeftest(modelFghtBMI, vcov.=FghtRobustBMIHC, df=modelFghtBMI$df.residual)

# AGE

AttrAgeTest <- coeftest(modelAttrAge, vcov.=AttrRobustAgeHC, df=modelAttrAge$df.residual)

FghtAgeTest <- coeftest(modelFghtAge, vcov.=FghtRobustAgeHC, df=modelFghtAge$df.residual)

# FULL

AttrTest <- coeftest(modelAttr, vcov.=AttrRobustHC, df=modelAttr$df.residual)

FghtTest <- coeftest(modelFght, vcov.=FghtRobustHC, df=modelFght$df.residual)

AttrTest

FghtTest
```

### Compute effect sizes

```{r}

# PARTIAL

AttrEffectSizes <- AttrTest[,"t value"]^2 / (AttrTest[,"t value"]^2 + modelAttr$df.residual)

FghtEffectSizes <- FghtTest[,"t value"]^2 / (FghtTest[,"t value"]^2 + modelAttr$df.residual)

round(AttrEffectSizes, digits=3)

round(FghtEffectSizes, digits=3)

# SEMI PARTIAL

AttrSummary <- summary(modelAttr)

FghtSummary <- summary(modelFght)

AttrReducedFFA <- lm(AttractivenessStd ~ fWHRStd + fWHR_FFA + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = averagedData)

AttrReducedSummaryFFA <- summary(AttrReducedFFA)

AttrReducedfWHR <- lm(AttractivenessStd ~ FFAStd + fWHR_FFA + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = averagedData)

AttrReducedSummaryfWHR <- summary(AttrReducedfWHR)

AttrReducedInt <- lm(AttractivenessStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = averagedData)

AttrReducedSummaryInt <- summary(AttrReducedInt)

FghtReducedFFA <- lm(FightingStd ~ fWHRStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = averagedData)

FghtReducedSummaryFFA <- summary(FghtReducedFFA)

FghtReducedfWHR <- lm(FightingStd ~ FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = averagedData)

FghtReducedSummaryfWHR <- summary(FghtReducedfWHR)

EtaAttrFFA <- AttrSummary$r.squared - AttrReducedSummaryFFA$r.squared

cat("Effect size for FFA on attractiveness is ", round(EtaAttrFFA, digits=3), "\n")

EtaAttrfWHR <- AttrSummary$r.squared - AttrReducedSummaryfWHR$r.squared

cat("Effect size for fWHR on attractiveness is ", round(EtaAttrfWHR, digits=3), "\n")

EtaAttrInt <- AttrSummary$r.squared - AttrReducedSummaryInt$r.squared

cat("Effect size for fWHR x FFA on attractiveness is ", round(EtaAttrInt, digits=3), "\n")

EtaFghtFFA <- FghtSummary$r.squared - FghtReducedSummaryFFA$r.squared

cat("Effect size for FFA on fighting ability is ", round(EtaFghtFFA, digits=3), "\n")

EtaFghtfWHR <- FghtSummary$r.squared - FghtReducedSummaryfWHR$r.squared

cat("Effect size for fWHR on fighting ability is ", round(EtaFghtfWHR, digits=3), "\n")

```

### Print table

#### Set up

```{r}

# Which rows to show (and in what order)
termOrder <- c("fWHRStd", "FFAStd", "fWHRStd:FFAStd", "BMIStd", "AgeStd", "(Intercept)")

# Pretty labels for the leftmost "Variable" column
termsMap <- c(
  "fWHRStd" = "fWHR (z)",
  "FFAStd"  = "FFA (z)",
  "fWHRStd:FFAStd" = "fWHR × FFA",
  "BMIStd"  = "BMI (z)",
  "AgeStd" = "Age (z)",
  "(Intercept)" = "Intercept"
)

predictors <- unname(termsMap)
```

#### Simple model

##### Attractiveness

```{r}

summaryAttrSimple <- summary(modelAttrSimple)

AttrOrderSimple <- match(termOrder, rownames(AttrSimpleTest))

AttrRejectionSimple <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df=modelAttr$df.residual)

AttrEstimatesSimple <- AttrSimpleTest[,"Estimate"][AttrOrderSimple]

AttrErrorsSimple <- AttrSimpleTest[,"Std. Error"][AttrOrderSimple]

AttrLowerSimple <- round(AttrEstimatesSimple - AttrRejectionSimple * AttrErrorsSimple, digits=3)

AttrUpperSimple <- round(AttrEstimatesSimple + AttrRejectionSimple * AttrErrorsSimple, digits=3)

AttrConfIntSimple <- ifelse(is.na(AttrLowerSimple) | is.na(AttrUpperSimple), "", paste0("[", AttrLowerSimple, " ,", AttrUpperSimple, "]"))
  
AttrStatSimple <- round(AttrSimpleTest[,"t value"][AttrOrderSimple], digits=3)

AttrPvalueSimple <- round(AttrSimpleTest[,"Pr(>|t|)"][AttrOrderSimple], digits=3)

AttrSimple <- tibble(Variable=predictors, Estimate=round(AttrEstimatesSimple, digits=3), SE=round(AttrErrorsSimple, digits=3), CI=AttrConfIntSimple, StatType="t", Stat=AttrStatSimple, df=paste0("(", modelAttrSimple$df.residual, ")"), p=AttrPvalueSimple, r= summaryAttrSimple$adj.r.squared, n=nobs(modelAttrSimple))
```

#### Consolidate table

```{r}

PvalueFunction <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p) || p == "") return("")
  p <- as.numeric(p)
  if (p < .001) "p<.001" else paste0("p=", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}

StatlineFunction <- function(statType, stat, p, df = "") {
  if (is.na(stat) || is.na(p) || stat == "" || p == "") return("")
  paste0(
    statType, df, "=", sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(stat)),
    ", ", PvalueFunction(p)
  )
}

sig_code <- function(p) {
  p <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.eE-]", "", as.character(p))))
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < .001) "<sup>***</sup>"
  else if (p < .01) "<sup>**</sup>"
  else if (p < .05) "<sup>*</sup>"
  else if (p < .10) "<sup>\u2020</sup>"  # dagger for 10%
  else ""
}

# Helper: build observations row
formatN <- function(df) {
  n  <- df$n[1]
  paste(n)
}

# Helper: build r squared row
formatR <- function(df) {
  r  <- round(df$r[1], digits=3)
  paste0("**", r, "**")
}

block <- function(x) ifelse(x == "" | is.na(x), "", paste0("<span style='display:block; white-space:nowrap;'>", x, "</span>"))

# Build cell (4 lines)
mk_cell <- function(df) {
  stars <- vapply(df$p, sig_code, FUN.VALUE = character(1))
  line1 <- ifelse(is.na(df$Estimate), "\u2014", paste0("**", df$Estimate, "**", stars)) |> block()
  line2 <- ifelse(is.na(df$SE), "", paste0("(", df$SE, ")")) |> block()
  line3 <- df$CI |> block()
  line4 <- mapply(StatlineFunction, df$StatType, df$Stat, df$p, df$df, SIMPLIFY = TRUE, USE.NAMES = FALSE) |> block()
  paste0(line1, line2, line3, line4)
}
```

```{r}

AttrSimple$Cell <- mk_cell(AttrSimple)
AttrBMI$Cell    <- mk_cell(AttrBMI)
AttrAge$Cell    <- mk_cell(AttrAge)
AttrFull$Cell   <- mk_cell(AttrFull)

FghtSimple$Cell <- mk_cell(FghtSimple)
FghtBMI$Cell    <- mk_cell(FghtBMI)
FghtAge$Cell    <- mk_cell(FghtAge)

# Reduce to one wide table
DataWide <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) dplyr::left_join(x, y, by = "Variable"),
  list(
    dplyr::transmute(AttrSimple,  Variable,  AttrSimple = Cell),
    dplyr::transmute(AttrBMI,     Variable,  AttrBMI    = Cell),
    dplyr::transmute(AttrAge,     Variable,  AttrAge    = Cell),
    dplyr::transmute(AttrFull,    Variable,  AttrFull   = Cell),
    dplyr::transmute(FghtSimple,  Variable,  FghtSimple = Cell),
    dplyr::transmute(FghtBMI,     Variable,  FghtBMI    = Cell),
    dplyr::transmute(FghtAge,     Variable,  FghtAge    = Cell)
  )
)

# Add r squared row
RsqRow <- data.frame(
  Variable              = "R\u00b2 adj.",
  AttrSimple            = formatR(AttrSimple),
  AttrBMI               = formatR(AttrBMI),
  AttrAge               = formatR(AttrAge),
  AttrFull              = formatR(AttrFull),
  FghtSimple            = formatR(FghtSimple),
  FghtBMI               = formatR(FghtBMI),
  FghtAge               = formatR(FghtAge),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Add observations row
ObsRow <- data.frame(
  Variable              = "Observations",
  AttrSimple            = formatN(AttrSimple),
  AttrBMI               = formatN(AttrBMI),
  AttrAge               = formatN(AttrAge),
  AttrFull              = formatN(AttrFull),
  FghtSimple            = formatN(FghtSimple),
  FghtBMI               = formatN(FghtBMI),
  FghtAge               = formatN(FghtAge),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

DataWide <- dplyr::bind_rows(DataWide, RsqRow, ObsRow)
```

#### Print

```{r}

gt_main <- DataWide |>
  gt(rowname_col = "Variable") |>
  # Two spanners: Attractiveness vs Fighting
  tab_spanner(label = md("**Attractiveness (z)**"),    columns = AttrSimple:AttrFull) |>
  tab_spanner(label = md("**Fighting Ability (z)**"),  columns = FghtSimple:FghtAge) |>
  # Optional: pretty inner labels (same for both sides)
  cols_label(
    AttrSimple = "(1)", AttrBMI = "(2)",
    AttrAge = "(3)", AttrFull = "(4)",
    FghtSimple = "(1)", FghtBMI = "(2)",
    FghtAge = "(3)"
  ) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = gt::px(11)) |>
  fmt_markdown(everything()) |>
  tab_source_note(md("**Note.** Ordinary least squares (OLS) on target-level averages (mean of 11 independent raters) for perceived attractiveness and fighting ability. Outcomes and predictors marked “(z)” are standardized (mean = 0, sd = 1); * p<.05, ** p<.01, *** p<.001; † p<.10. Parentheses show Huber–White heteroskedasticity-consistent standard errors (HC3); square brackets denote 95% confidence intervals. fWHR=Facial Weight to Hight Ratio; FFA=Fluctuating Facial Asymmetry; BMI=Body Mass Index. All values were rounded to 3 decimal places.")) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "justify"),
    locations = cells_source_notes()
  )

gt_main <- gt_main |>
  # Header left
  tab_header(title = md("*Table 3. The Dual Function Hypothesis*")) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(size = px(11), align = "left"),
    locations = list(
      cells_title(groups = "title"),
      cells_title(groups = "subtitle")
    )
  ) |>
  # Body: left-align Variable, center the rest
  cols_align(align = "left",   columns = "Variable") |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Variable) |>
  # (Optional) center column labels and spanner labels
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "center"),
            locations = cells_column_labels(columns = everything())) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "center"),
            locations = cells_column_spanners())


gt_main
```

```{r}

gtsave(gt_main, "MAIN_TABLE.html", inline_css = TRUE)

# higher zoom = sharper text; expand adds padding so nothing gets clipped
gtsave(
  gt_main,
  filename = "MAIN_TABLE.png",
  vwidth = 1300,
  expand = 5         # pixels of padding around the table
)
```

## Within Cluster Robustness Check

### Pooled OLS with clustering on rater

```{r}

dataLong$Rater <- as.factor(dataLong$Rater)

modelAttrClust <- lm(AttractivenessStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + fWHRStd*FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = dataLong)

AttrClustSummary <- summary(modelAttrClust)

AttrClustRobustCR <- vcovCR(modelAttrClust,  cluster = dataLong$Rater, type = "CR2")

# AttrClustRobustHC <- vcovCR(modelAttrClust,  cluster = 1:length(dataLong$Rater), type = "CR2")

AttrClustRobustSE <- sqrt(diag(AttrClustRobustCR))

modelFghtClust <- lm(FightingStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = dataLong)

FghtClustSummary <- summary(modelFghtClust)

FghtClustRobustCR <- vcovCR(modelFghtClust,  cluster = dataLong$Rater, type = "CR2")

#FghtClustRobustHC <- vcovCR(modelFghtClust,  cluster = 1:length(dataLong$Rater), type = "CR2")

FghtClustRobustSE <- sqrt(diag(FghtClustRobustCR))

stargazer(modelAttrClust, modelFghtClust, se=list(AttrClustRobustSE, FghtClustRobustSE), type="text")
```

#### Satterthwaite t-tests

```{r}

AttrClustTest <- coef_test(modelAttrClust, vcov=AttrClustRobustCR, test = "Satterthwaite")

FghtClustTest <- coef_test(modelFghtClust, vcov=FghtClustRobustCR, test = "Satterthwaite")

AttrClustTest

FghtClustTest
```

#### Wild Cluster Restricted Bootstrap

##### Attractiveness

```{r}

modelAttrWCR <- feols(AttractivenessStd ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + fWHRStd*FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, data = dataLong)

# Attractiveness model: single-parameter tests
bt_atr_ffa <- boottest(
  modelAttrWCR,
  clustid = "Rater",
  param   = "FFAStd",
  B       = 9999,
  type    = "webb",
)
summary(bt_atr_ffa)

bt_atr_fWHR <- boottest(
  modelAttrWCR,
  clustid = "Rater",
  param   = "fWHRStd",
  B       = 9999,
  type    = "webb",
)
summary(bt_atr_fWHR)

bt_atr_fWHR_ffa <- boottest(
  modelAttrWCR,
  clustid = "Rater",
  param   = "fWHRStd:FFAStd",
  B       = 9999,
  type    = "webb",
)
summary(bt_atr_fWHR_ffa)

bt_atr_bmi <- boottest(
  modelAttrWCR,
  clustid = "Rater",
  param   = "BMIStd",
  B       = 9999,
  type    = "webb",
)
summary(bt_atr_bmi)

bt_atr_age <- boottest(
  modelAttrWCR,
  clustid = "Rater",
  param   = "AgeStd",
  B       = 9999,
  type    = "webb",
)
summary(bt_atr_age)

bt_atr_int <- boottest(
  modelAttrWCR,
  clustid = "Rater",
  param   = "(Intercept)",
  B       = 9999,
  type    = "webb",
)
summary(bt_atr_int)

```

### Random Intercepts and Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC)

Obtain ICC from a random intercept hierarchical model, approximation assuming normality.

#### Simple ICC

Fit a simple random intercept model, recover ICC

```{r}

modelAttrNull <- lmer(AttractivenessStd ~ 1 + (1|Rater), data = dataLong)
v_u <- as.numeric(VarCorr(modelAttrNull)$Rater[1])  # between-rater variance
v_e <- sigma(modelAttrNull)^2                       # within-rater variance
AttrNullICC <- v_u / (v_u + v_e)
AttrNullICC

modelFghtNull <- lmer(FightingStd ~ 1 + (1|Rater), data = dataLong)
v_u <- as.numeric(VarCorr(modelFghtNull)$Rater[1])  # between-rater variance
v_e <- sigma(modelFghtNull)^2                       # within-rater variance
FghtNullICC <- v_u / (v_u + v_e)
FghtNullICC
```

#### Random Intercepts

Fit the full model, recover ICC

```{r}

modelAttrMixed <- lmer(AttractivenessStd ~ 1 + fWHRStd + FFAStd + fWHRStd*FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd + (1|Rater), data = dataLong)

v_u <- as.numeric(VarCorr(modelAttrMixed)$Rater[1])  # between-rater variance
v_e <- sigma(modelAttrMixed)^2                       # within-rater variance
AttrICC <- v_u / (v_u + v_e)
AttrICC

AttrMixedRobustCR <- vcovCR(modelAttrMixed,  cluster = dataLong$Rater, type = "CR2")

AttrMixedRobustSE <- sqrt(diag(AttrMixedRobustCR))

modelFghtMixed <- lmer(FightingStd ~ 1 + fWHRStd + FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd + (1|Rater), data = dataLong)

v_u <- as.numeric(VarCorr(modelFghtMixed)$Rater[1])  # between-rater variance
v_e <- sigma(modelFghtMixed)^2                       # within-rater variance
FghtICC <- v_u / (v_u + v_e)
FghtICC

FghtMixedRobustCR <- vcovCR(modelFghtMixed,  cluster = dataLong$Rater, type = "CR2")

FghtMixedRobustSE <- sqrt(diag(FghtMixedRobustCR))

stargazer(modelAttrMixed, modelFghtMixed, se=list(AttrMixedRobustSE, FghtMixedRobustSE), type="text")
```

#### Satterthwaite t-tests

```{r}

AttrMixedTest <- coef_test(modelAttrMixed, vcov=AttrMixedRobustCR, test = "Satterthwaite")

FghtMixedTest <- coef_test(modelFghtMixed, vcov=FghtMixedRobustCR, test = "Satterthwaite")

AttrMixedTest

FghtMixedTest
```

### Clustered Ordered Logit

```{r}

modelAttrOrdered <- polr(
  Attractiveness ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + fWHRStd*FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd,
  data = dataLong, method = "logistic", Hess = TRUE
)

AttrOrderedRobustCL <- vcovCL(modelAttrOrdered,  cluster = dataLong$Rater, type = "HC1", cadjust = TRUE)

#AttrOrderedRobustHC <- vcovCL(modelAttrOrdered,  cluster = 1:length(dataLong$Rater), type = "HC1", cadjust=FALSE)

AttrOrderedRobustSE <- sqrt(diag(AttrOrderedRobustCL))

modelFghtOrdered <- polr(
  Fighting ~ fWHRStd + FFAStd + BMIStd + AgeStd, 
  data = dataLong, method = "logistic", Hess = TRUE
  )

FghtOrderedRobustCL <- vcovCL(modelFghtOrdered,  cluster = dataLong$Rater, type = "HC1", cadjust = TRUE)

#FghtOrderedRobustHC <- vcovCL(modelFghtOrdered,  cluster = 1:length(dataLong$Rater), type = "HC1", cadjust=FALSE)

FghtOrderedRobustSE <- sqrt(diag(FghtOrderedRobustCL))



stargazer(modelAttrOrdered, modelFghtOrdered, se=list(AttrOrderedRobustSE, FghtOrderedRobustSE), type="text")
```

```{r}

AttrOrderedTest <- coeftest(modelAttrOrdered, vcov.=AttrOrderedRobustCL)

FghtOrderedTest <- coeftest(modelFghtOrdered, vcov.=FghtOrderedRobustCL)

AttrOrderedTest

FghtOrderedTest
```

### Print tables

#### Set up

```{r}

# Which rows to show (and in what order)
AttrTermOrder <- c("FFAStd", "fWHRStd", "fWHRStd:FFAStd", "BMIStd", "AgeStd")

FghtTermOrder <- c("FFAStd", "fWHRStd", "BMIStd", "AgeStd")

# Pretty labels for the leftmost "Variable" column
AttrTermsMap <- c(
  "FFAStd"  = "FFA (z)",
  "fWHRStd" = "fWHR (z)",
  "fWHRStd:FFAStd" = "fWHR × FFA",
  "BMIStd"  = "BMI (z)",
  "AgeStd" = "Age (z)"
)

# Pretty labels for the leftmost "Variable" column
FghtTermsMap <- c(
  "FFAStd"  = "FFA (z)",
  "fWHRStd" = "fWHR (z)",
  "BMIStd"  = "BMI (z)",
  "AgeStd" = "Age (z)"
)

AttrVar <- unname(AttrTermsMap)
FghtVar <- unname(FghtTermsMap)
```

#### OLS HC

##### Attractiveness

```{r}

# Table for main OLS

AttrOrderOLSHC <- match(AttrTermOrder, rownames(AttrTest))

AttrRejectionOLSHC <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df=modelAttr$df.residual)

AttrEstimatesOLSHC <- AttrTest[,"Estimate"][AttrOrderOLSHC]

AttrErrorsOLSHC <- AttrTest[,"Std. Error"][AttrOrderOLSHC]

AttrLowerOLSHC <- round(AttrEstimatesOLSHC - AttrRejectionOLSHC * AttrErrorsOLSHC, digits=3)

AttrUpperOLSHC <- round(AttrEstimatesOLSHC + AttrRejectionOLSHC * AttrErrorsOLSHC, digits=3)

AttrConfIntOLSHC <- paste0("[", AttrLowerOLSHC, " ,", AttrUpperOLSHC, "]")
  
AttrStatOLSHC <- round(AttrTest[,"t value"][AttrOrderOLSHC], digits=3)

AttrPvalueOLSHC <- round(AttrTest[,"Pr(>|t|)"][AttrOrderOLSHC], digits=3)

AttrOLSHC <- data.frame(Variable=AttrVar, Estimate=as.character(round(AttrEstimatesOLSHC, digits=3)), SE=round(AttrErrorsOLSHC, digits=3), CI=AttrConfIntOLSHC, StatType="t", Stat=AttrStatOLSHC, df=paste0("(", modelAttr$df.residual, ")"), p=AttrPvalueOLSHC, n=nobs(modelAttr), clusters="\u2014")
```

#### Consolidate tables

```{r}

# Helper: build "N=...,<br>Clusters=..." for a given spec df
formatN <- function(df) {
  n  <- df$n[1]
  cl <- df$clusters[1]
  paste0("N=", n, "<br>Clusters=", cl)
}

# Build cell (4 lines)
mk_cell <- function(df) {
  stars <- vapply(df$p, sig_code, FUN.VALUE = character(1))
  line1 <- ifelse(df$Estimate=="", "\u2014", paste0("**", df$Estimate, "**", stars)) |> block()
  line2 <- ifelse(df$SE=="", "", paste0("(", df$SE, ")")) |> block()
  line3 <- df$CI |> block()
  line4 <- mapply(StatlineFunction, df$StatType, df$Stat, df$p, df$df, SIMPLIFY = TRUE, USE.NAMES = FALSE) |> block()
  paste0(line1, line2, line3, line4)
}
```

## Halo effect Robustness Check (SEM)

### Simultaneous SEM (Recursiveness test)

```{r}

averagedData$fWHR_FFA <- with(averagedData, fWHRStd * FFAStd)

model <- '
  # Attractiveness equation (labels b1..b5)
  AttractivenessStd ~ b1*FightingStd + b2*FFAStd + b3*fWHR_FFA + b4*BMIStd

  # Fighting equation (labels c1..c5)
  FightingStd ~ c1*AttractivenessStd + c2*fWHRStd + c3*FFAStd + c4*BMIStd + c5*AgeStd
'

fit_simul <- sem(model, estimator = "MLR", missing   = "fiml", data = averagedData)
summary(fit_simul, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```

#### Instrument Check

```{r}

Attr2SLS <- feols(AttractivenessStd ~ FFAStd + fWHR_FFA + BMIStd | FightingStd ~ fWHRStd + AgeStd, data=averagedData, vcov = "HC1")

Fght2SLS <- feols(FightingStd ~ FFAStd + fWHRStd + BMIStd + AgeStd | AttractivenessStd ~ fWHR_FFA, data=averagedData, vcov = "HC1")

summary(Attr2SLS)


fitstat(Attr2SLS, c("ivf1", "kpr", "wh", "sargan"))

summary(Fght2SLS)

fitstat(Fght2SLS, c("ivf1", "kpr", "wh", "sargan"))


```

### Recursive SEM

```{r}

averagedData$fWHR_FFA <- with(averagedData, fWHRStd * FFAStd)

model <- '
  # Attractiveness equation (labels b1..b5)
  AttractivenessStd ~ b1*fWHRStd + b2*FFAStd + b3*fWHR_FFA + b4*BMIStd + b5*AgeStd

  # Fighting equation (labels c1..c5)
  FightingStd ~ c1*AttractivenessStd + c2*fWHRStd + c3*FFAStd + c4*BMIStd + c5*AgeStd

  # Conditional indirect effect of FFA via Attractiveness at fWHR = w
  ind_FFA_wm1 := c1*(b2 + b3*(-1))   # w = -1 SD
  ind_FFA_w0  := c1*(b2 + b3*0)      # w =  0
  ind_FFA_w1  := c1*(b2 + b3*(1))    # w = +1 SD

  # Direct effect (does not depend on w)
  dir_FFA := c3

  # Conditional total effects
  tot_FFA_wm1 := dir_FFA + ind_FFA_wm1
  tot_FFA_w0  := dir_FFA + ind_FFA_w0
  tot_FFA_w1  := dir_FFA + ind_FFA_w1
'

fit_recur <- sem(model, estimator = "MLR", missing   = "fiml", data = averagedData)
summary(fit_recur, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(fit_recur, standardized = TRUE)[, c("label","lhs","op","rhs","est","se","pvalue")]
```

### Print tables

```{r}

# Add this:
sig_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < .001) return("<sup>***</sup>")
  if (p < .01)  return("<sup>**</sup>")
  if (p < .05)  return("<sup>*</sup>")
  if (p < .10)  return("<sup>\u2020</sup>")  # dagger for 10%
  return("")
}

# -------- helpers (reuse your fmt_p) --------
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < .001, "<.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))


# Replace your mk_cell() with this version:
block <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "", "", paste0(
  "<span style='display:block; white-space:nowrap;'>", x, "</span>"
))

mk_cell <- function(est, se, z, p, lo, hi) {
  star  <- sig_stars(p)
  line1 <- ifelse(is.na(est), "", paste0("**", sprintf("%.3f", est), "**", star)) |> block()
  line2 <- ifelse(is.na(se),  "", paste0("(", sprintf("%.3f", se), ")")) |> block()
  line3 <- ifelse(is.na(lo) | is.na(hi), "", paste0("[", sprintf("%.3f", lo), ", ", sprintf("%.3f", hi), "]")) |> block()
  line4 <- ifelse(is.na(z) | is.na(p), "", paste0("z=", sprintf("%.3f", z), ", p=", fmt_p(p))) |> block()
  paste0(line1, line2, line3, line4)
}

lavaan_reg_tidy <- function(fit, model_name) {
  pe <- parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
  pe <- dplyr::filter(pe, op == "~")
  tibble::tibble(
    Model    = model_name,
    Equation = pe$lhs,
    Predictor= pe$rhs,
    est      = pe$est,
    se       = pe$se,
    z        = pe$z,
    p        = pe$pvalue,
    lo       = pe$ci.lower,
    hi       = pe$ci.upper
  ) |>
  # 👇 build one HTML cell per row (scalar calls)
  dplyr::mutate(Cell = mapply(mk_cell, est, se, z, p, lo, hi, USE.NAMES = FALSE)) |>
  dplyr::select(Model, Equation, Predictor, Cell)
}


# -------- R² per equation (to show as a dedicated row) --------
lavaan_r2_tidy <- function(fit, model_name) {
  r2 <- as.numeric(inspect(fit, "r2"))
  if (length(r2) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())
  eqs <- names(inspect(fit, "r2"))
  tibble::tibble(
    Model    = model_name,
    Equation = eqs,
    Predictor= "R\u00b2",   # will become the row label
    Cell     = paste0("**", sprintf("%.3f", r2), "**")
  )
}

# -------- N (observations) per model/equation --------
# Uses lavaan's total N (accounts for FIML). If you prefer per-group, swap to nobs(fit).
lavaan_n_tidy <- function(fit, model_name) {
  # total sample size (across groups) as reported by lavaan
  n_total <- as.integer(lavaan::fitMeasures(fit, "ntotal"))

  # figure out which equations exist in this fit (lhs of regressions)
  eqs <- unique(dplyr::filter(lavaan::parameterEstimates(fit), op == "~")$lhs)
  if (length(eqs) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  tibble::tibble(
    Model    = model_name,
    Equation = eqs,
    Predictor= "Observations",
    Cell     = paste0(format(n_total, big.mark = ","))
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Col = paste0(Model, " \u2014 ",
                 dplyr::if_else(Equation == "AttractivenessStd", "Attractiveness", "Fighting"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Predictor, Col, Cell)
}

# -------- build long (both models), then pivot wider --------
rec_long <- lavaan_reg_tidy(fit_recur,  "Recursive")
sim_long <- lavaan_reg_tidy(fit_simul,  "Simultaneous")

pred_order <- c(
  "FFAStd","fWHRStd","fWHR_FFA","BMIStd","AgeStd","AttractivenessStd","FightingStd",
  "Total FFA at fWHR = -1 SD",
  "Total FFA at fWHR = 0 SD",
  "Total FFA at fWHR = +1 SD",
  "R\u00b2",
  "Observations"
)

long_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(rec_long, sim_long) |>
  # keep only predictors that appear in any equation (the join will em-dash the rest)
  dplyr::filter(Predictor %in% unique(c(pred_order, Predictor))) |>
  # make a nice column name per model × equation
  dplyr::mutate(Col = paste0(Model, " — ", dplyr::if_else(Equation == "AttractivenessStd", "Attractiveness", "Fighting"))) |>
  dplyr::select(Predictor, Col, Cell)

# add R² as its own "predictor" row
rec_r2 <- lavaan_r2_tidy(fit_recur, "Recursive") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Col = paste0(Model, " — ", dplyr::if_else(Equation == "AttractivenessStd", "Attractiveness", "Fighting"))) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Predictor = "R\u00b2", Col, Cell)

sim_r2 <- lavaan_r2_tidy(fit_simul, "Simultaneous") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Col = paste0(Model, " — ", dplyr::if_else(Equation == "AttractivenessStd", "Attractiveness", "Fighting"))) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Predictor = "R\u00b2", Col, Cell)

long_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(long_all, rec_r2, sim_r2)

# --- extract total effects from recursive fit
pe_rec  <- parameterEstimates(fit_recur, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE)

tot_labels <- c("tot_FFA_wm1","tot_FFA_w0","tot_FFA_w1")
tot_names <- c("-1 SD","0 SD","+1 SD")  # no leading space before +1

tot_rows <- dplyr::filter(pe_rec, op == ":=", label %in% tot_labels)

# build tidy tibble with one row per total effect
tot_long <- tibble::tibble(
  Predictor = paste0("Total FFA at fWHR = ",
                     tot_names[match(tot_rows$label, tot_labels)]),
  Col       = "Recursive \u2014 Fighting",
  Cell      = mapply(
    mk_cell,
    est = tot_rows$est,
    se  = tot_rows$se,
    z   = tot_rows$z,
    p   = tot_rows$pvalue,
    lo  = tot_rows$ci.lower,
    hi  = tot_rows$ci.upper,
    USE.NAMES = FALSE
  )
)


# append totals to your long data
long_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(long_all, tot_long)


# build N rows
rec_n <- lavaan_n_tidy(fit_recur, "Recursive")
sim_n <- lavaan_n_tidy(fit_simul, "Simultaneous")

# append ONLY N
long_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(long_all, rec_n, sim_n)

# pivot to wide: one column per equation per model
wide_eq <- tidyr::pivot_wider(long_all, names_from = Col, values_from = Cell) |>
  # order rows by your preferred predictor order, with R² at bottom
  dplyr::mutate(Predictor = factor(Predictor, levels = pred_order)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Predictor) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-Predictor, ~ ifelse(is.na(.x) | .x == "", "\u2014", .x)))

pretty_map <- c(
  "FFAStd"="FFA (z)", "fWHRStd"="fWHR (z)", "fWHR_FFA"="fWHR × FFA",
  "BMIStd"="BMI (z)", "AgeStd"="Age (z)", "AttractivenessStd"="Attractiveness (z)",

# -------- pretty print with gt (side-by-side columns) --------
```

## Generalizability study

One facet crossed design targets x raters (p x i)

```{r}

k <- 11

AttrGen <- lmer(AttractivenessStd ~ 1 + (1|Cod) + (1|Rater), data = dataLong)

AttrSigmaTar  <- as.numeric(VarCorr(AttrGen)$Cod[1])
AttrSigmaRat  <- as.numeric(VarCorr(AttrGen)$Rater[1])
AttrSigmaError <- sigma(AttrGen)^2

FghtGen <- lmer(FightingStd ~ 1 + (1|Cod) + (1|Rater), data = dataLong)

FghtSigmaTar  <- as.numeric(VarCorr(FghtGen)$Cod[1])
FghtSigmaRat  <- as.numeric(VarCorr(FghtGen)$Rater[1])
FghtSigmaError <- sigma(FghtGen)^2

# ------------- RELIABILITY ATTRACTIVENESS ---------------

AttrSingleRaterG  <- AttrSigmaTar / (AttrSigmaTar + AttrSigmaError)
AttrSingleRaterPhi <- AttrSigmaTar / (AttrSigmaTar + AttrSigmaRat + AttrSigmaError)

c(AttrSingleG = AttrSingleRaterG, AttrSinglePhi = AttrSingleRaterPhi)

AttrRaterG  <- AttrSigmaTar / (AttrSigmaTar + AttrSigmaError/k)
AttrRaterPhi <- AttrSigmaTar / (AttrSigmaTar + AttrSigmaRat/k + AttrSigmaError/k)

c(AttrG = AttrRaterG, AttrPhi = AttrRaterPhi)

# ------------- RELIABILITY FIGHTING ---------------

FghtSingleRaterG  <- FghtSigmaTar / (FghtSigmaTar + FghtSigmaError)
FghtSingleRaterPhi <- FghtSigmaTar / (FghtSigmaTar + FghtSigmaRat + FghtSigmaError)

c(FghtSingleG = FghtSingleRaterG, FghtSinglePhi = FghtSingleRaterPhi)

FghtRaterG  <- FghtSigmaTar / (FghtSigmaTar + FghtSigmaError/k)
FghtRaterPhi <- FghtSigmaTar / (FghtSigmaTar + FghtSigmaRat/k + FghtSigmaError/k)

c(FghtG = FghtRaterG, FghtPhi = FghtRaterPhi)
```

```{r}

# set k (common number of raters per target)
k <- 11

gt_df <- tibble(
  Construct   = c("Attractiveness", "Fighting Ability"),
  Single_G    = c(AttrSigmaTar / (AttrSigmaTar + AttrSigmaError),
                  FghtSigmaTar / (FghtSigmaTar + FghtSigmaError)),
  Single_Phi  = c(AttrSigmaTar / (AttrSigmaTar + AttrSigmaRat + AttrSigmaError),
                  FghtSigmaTar / (FghtSigmaTar + FghtSigmaRat + FghtSigmaError)),
  MeanK_G     = c(AttrSigmaTar / (AttrSigmaTar + AttrSigmaError / k),
                  FghtSigmaTar / (FghtSigmaTar + FghtSigmaError / k)),
  MeanK_Phi   = c(AttrSigmaTar / (AttrSigmaTar + (AttrSigmaRat + AttrSigmaError) / k),
                  FghtSigmaTar / (FghtSigmaTar + (FghtSigmaRat + FghtSigmaError) / k))
)

gt_gen <- gt_df |>
  gt(rowname_col = "Construct") |>
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 3) |>
  cols_label(
    Single_G   = md("**ρ²**"),
    Single_Phi = md("**Φ**"),
    MeanK_G    = md("**ρ²**"),
    MeanK_Phi  = md("**Φ**")
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(label = md("**G Study** *(single rater, k = 1)*"),
              columns = c(Single_G, Single_Phi)) |>
  tab_spanner(label = md("**D Study** *(mean across raters, k = 11)*"),
              columns = c(MeanK_G, MeanK_Phi)) |>
  tab_header(title = md("*Table 4. Generalizability Theory Analysis*")) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = gt::px(11)) |>
  cols_align(align = "left",   columns = "Construct") |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Construct) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(size = px(11), align = "left"),
    locations = list(
      cells_title(groups = "title"),
      cells_title(groups = "subtitle")
    )
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(
    md("**Note.** Reliability of target means relative to rater sampling error. G = Generalizability; D = Decision; ρ² = Generalizability Coefficient (relative); Φ = Dependability Coefficient (absolute). Estimated from a crossed one-facet (target × rater) random-effects model.")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "justify"),
    locations = cells_source_notes()
  )
```
